build.ci_signing: Disposable CI key; the private retained release key is not sent to CI. CI and delivered APK are distinct builds from the same app sources.

requirements.independent_window: User-started TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY owned by a specialUse foreground service; drag header and resize grip.
requirements.main_task_removal: stopWithTask=false; onTaskRemoved persists state without stopping window.
requirements.close: Explicit close clears user-active state, removes window/notification, stops Choreographer and sensor listeners.
requirements.compact_task_view: Below 550 dp usable height, below 330 dp width, or landscape: controls move to menu; camera and time remain unchanged.
requirements.os_control: Force-stop, user stopping active apps, memory pressure and system overlay hiding remain possible and are not bypassed.
requirements.screen_off: Code pauses rendering/sensors while screen off or keyguard locked; no wake lock.
requirements.performance: Vsync-driven rendering requesting at least 60 Hz / best equal-resolution display mode; actual onDraw rate reported separately.

user_recording_review.observation: Native PiP already transitions into Samsung split screen; old large controls compress the map to a narrow strip.
user_recording_review.disappearance_cause: No spontaneous close or crash conclusively established from this recording.
user_recording_review.video_privacy: User recording and personal screenshots not included in repository.

apk.signature_verification: v2 and v3 signatures verified; retained release certificate matches v0.2.0 onward

harness_corrections.issue: Native PopupMenu adapter row was enabled and visible but reported clickable=false.
harness_corrections.correction: Tap only the identified focused PopupWindow adapter row, then retain the resulting Ost 90°/42° direction assertion.

harness_corrections.issue: The first all-window accessibility list sometimes contained only the status bar.
harness_corrections.correction: Use the existing five-second availability budget to wait for a focused/active visible root. Default probe mode unchanged.

harness_corrections.issue: An extra unguarded snapshot after successful UI/WindowManager verification temporarily omitted a live overlay.
harness_corrections.correction: Return the successful observation from the existing poll. No change to timeout, geometry, sensor, lifecycle or performance criteria.

harness_corrections.issue: Non-focused overlay over Home was omitted from accessibility while the actual WindowManager surface, service, sensors and rendering continued.
harness_corrections.correction: Require strict owned TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY surface visibility/drawn state and display bounds. Preserve semantic accessibility requirements for initial start/drag/resize. Explicit close can use previously observed enabled X geometry only at unchanged window dimensions with a freshly verified window frame. Negative fixtures for hidden surface, wrong owner and changed size were rejected.

harness_corrections.issue: Android 15 SettingsHomepageActivity deliberately hides non-system overlays. WindowManager recorded mForceHideNonSystemOverlayWindow=true, mPolicyVisibility=false, shown=false and isVisible=false while the window and foreground service still existed.
harness_corrections.correction: Use the installed Chrome launcher activity as the positive ordinary-foreign-app visibility fixture. Retain the same surface, lifecycle, sensor and performance assertions. Document the protected-window limit; no system protection was bypassed.

harness_corrections.result: All eleven overlay integration checks passed. No subsequent app changes or runtime test changes.

limits.samsung_split_screen_ui: User recording established pre-existing docking; new compact layout is tested with wm size, not a Samsung emulator.
limits.minimum_60_presented_fps: NOT_ESTABLISHED; emulator functional success is separate from its measured render performance.
limits.permission_grant_ui: Static flow/API review; CI grants overlay and notifications for deterministic setup.
limits.process_kill_recovery: START_STICKY best effort is implemented; process-death restoration not tested.
limits.legacy_android_26_29: Side navigation correction compiled and statically reviewed; no API 26–29 runtime run.
limits.screen_lock_pause: Lifecycle implementation reviewed; no additional dedicated screen-lock runtime check.
limits.test_duration: Short deterministic integration observations, not a long-duration endurance test. Continued motion/frame collection was six seconds per overlay phase; explicit close was followed by six seconds of quiet observation.
limits.actual_foreign_task_embedding: Overlay sits above apps and is not embedded in another app’s task. Native SkyActivity remains the path for Samsung split-screen/pop-up docking.

performance.interpretation: Functional test success is separate from performance. No phase confirmed nominal 60 render FPS. onDraw counts and draw CPU duration do not establish compositor-presented FPS. These software-emulator rates cannot be transferred to the phone; v0.4.0 physical-device benchmark was not performed.

protected_window_diagnosis.scope: Does not assert every Settings page or vendor Settings variant uses the same policy.
